notes: Support and Tickets: the View user panel now shows song status history, deletion history, and a Warn Artist action, matching Moderation. Ban Artist now requires a reason before it can be submitted.

windows_notes: Fixed the Support/Tickets ticket-sync gap that had been silently building up for weeks (Freshdesk background sync had gotten switched off) - Tickets is now fully caught up and Freshdesk has been retired. Fixed a bug that could create empty support tickets from HTML-only emails, added auto-refresh to the Tickets list, fixed the mail and Tickets unread/status badges getting stuck stale when the app sat unfocused for a while, and fixed a dark rectangle showing on the Calendar in light mode.
